name: 原生接入
Native adapter
responsibility: 登录、认证消息收发、业务 UID 与 NIM 身份映射
Login, authenticated messaging, business UID / NIM mapping
boundary: 只处理启用群；不根据昵称或群号猜测身份
Enabled groups only; never infer identity from names or display group numbers

name: 框架鉴权
Framework authorization
responsibility: 根据当前会话有效配置的 admins_id 识别操作者
Resolve caller authority from the session's effective admins_id
boundary: 昵称、平台群角色、@ 管理员及模型输出不能授予权限
Names, upstream group roles, admin mentions and model output never grant authority

name: 固定命令
Deterministic commands
responsibility: 整条消息识别、公共命令分流、目录快照及参数校验
Exact message recognition, public-command routing, directory snapshots and validation
boundary: 不进入模型；编号按账号、操作者和私聊会话隔离，十分钟过期
No model call; snapshot numbers expire in ten minutes and bind account, caller and private session

name: 私聊 AI 管理
Private AI management
responsibility: wsl_private_management 固定工具复用命令服务
wsl_private_management uses fixed actions and the shared command service
boundary: 仅管理员私聊；规则与活动参数预览确认，定时另需确认；不得修改身份、授权或凭据
Admin private chat only; preview/confirm rules and activity parameters, with separate schedule confirmation; no identity, grant or credential changes

name: 上下文审核
Contextual review
responsibility: 独立模型审核当前消息与同群上下文，故障时高置信规则兜底
Independent model review of current and same-group context; high-confidence fallback on failure
boundary: 明确正常或证据不足不罚；群主、管理员和机器人受保护；历史消息不追罚
Allow or insufficient evidence means no sanction; protected roles and bots remain exempt; no historical sanctions

name: 处罚执行与升级
Sanctions and escalation
responsibility: 最终动作授权、原生角色和目标校验、幂等执行、先三次禁言再违规踢出
Final capability, upstream-role and target checks; idempotent execution; removal on a new violation after three mutes
boundary: 三次自动禁言后第四次违规踢出需单独启用；人工禁言不累计；未知结果不重试
Removal on the fourth violation after three accepted mutes is opt-in; manual mutes do not count; unknown operations are not retried

name: 每日发言排行
Daily rankings
responsibility: 北京时间当天有效文字计数、分页、原生 @
Asia/Shanghai daily eligible text counts, pagination and native mentions
boundary: 只读本实例已收到的记录；排除机器人、命令与已确认违规；不自动派奖
Only records received by this instance; exclude bots, commands and confirmed violations; no automatic prizes

name: 群抽奖
Group lotteries
responsibility: 管理员设置、群员报名、倒计时开奖、持久化名单
Admin settings, member enrollment, deadline drawing and durable winner lists
boundary: 开启时冻结参数；发布须群主动发送授权；奖品由联系人发放，不自动付款
Settings freeze at opening; publication requires proactive group grants; contact distributes prizes, no automatic payment

name: 邀请归属与奖励
Invitation attribution and rewards
responsibility: 平台邀请归属、待审核只读记录、新成员去重计奖
Native attribution, read-only pending records and deduplicated newcomer credits
boundary: 已有成员作基线；待审核、归属不明和重复入群不计奖；积分不是现金
Existing members form the baseline; pending, unknown and repeated joins earn no credits; points are not cash

name: 每日定时禁言
Daily group schedules
responsibility: 北京时间时段预览、确认、未来边界调度及审计
Asia/Shanghai interval preview, confirmation, future-boundary scheduling and audit
boundary: 创建者撤权、断线、错过边界或未知结果暂停；暂停和删除不自动解禁
Revoked creator authority, offline state, missed boundaries or uncertainty pause jobs; pause/delete never automatically unmute

name: 成员批量维护
Member batch maintenance
responsibility: 名片预览与执行、封禁和注销账号清理、进度与停止
Card preview/execution, banned/cancelled-account cleanup, progress and stop
boundary: rename 与 cleanup 分别授权；保护群管理角色；未知结果先回读
Separate rename and cleanup grants; protected group roles; read back unknown results first

name: 回复与撤回
Replies and recall
responsibility: 纯文本整理、脱敏、原生 @、功能回复受理20秒后撤回
Plain-text presentation, redaction, native mentions and feature recall twenty seconds after acceptance
boundary: 仅撤回机器人对应群回复；抽奖通知与报名反馈、私聊、成员命令及普通 AI 回复不撤回
Only matching group feature replies; lottery notices and signup replies, private chat, member commands and ordinary AI replies are kept

name: 插件管理页
Plugin management page
responsibility: 配置版本校验、逐群授权、近期审计、架构与权限对照
Revision checks, per-group grants, bounded audit, architecture and permission reference
boundary: 须 Dashboard JWT 与 bot 权限；不暴露凭证，不提供直接处罚和重试入口
Dashboard JWT and bot scope required; no credentials, direct sanctions or retry controls

name: 持久化与测试门禁
Persistence and test gates
responsibility: 按实例保存消息、操作、活动和任务；限时单向受控测试
Instance-scoped messages, operations, activities and jobs; bounded one-way controlled tests
boundary: 测试最多300秒、10条入站；不授予管理员或动作权限；重启关闭窗口
At most 300 seconds and ten inbound messages; no admin or capability grants; windows close on restart

name: 每日排名
Daily ranking
rule: 群需启用且允许回复；私聊管理员须先选群；不派奖
Enabled group and replies required; private admins select a group first; no prizes

name: 抽奖状态
Lottery status
rule: 未开活动时仅返回状态，不创建活动
Without an active lottery, return status only; do not create one

name: 抽奖报名
Lottery enrollment
rule: 只在活动群报名；重复成员不重复记入；不满足邀请门槛则拒绝
Enroll in the activity group only; deduplicate members; enforce invitation gate

name: 个人邀请与积分
Own invitations and points
rule: 只查询操作者自己的有效邀请和积分；不自动支付
Only the caller's eligible invitations and points; no automatic payment

name: 帮助与身份
Help and identity
rule: 非管理员私聊连帮助和 sid 也只返回无权限
Non-admin private help and sid also return only permission denial

name: 群与成员目录
Group and member directory
rule: 目录编号十分钟有效，绑定机器人、操作者和私聊会话
Directory numbers expire in ten minutes and bind bot, caller and private session

name: 权限与规则查询
Capabilities and rule queries
rule: 只读查询；开发门禁命令不创建窗口、不增加权限
Read-only; the gate command neither opens a window nor grants authority

name: 成员禁言
Mute member
rule: 群内须真实 @；私聊用快照编号；默认30分钟，整数1至1440分钟，无二次确认
Native mention in group; snapshot number privately; default thirty minutes, integer 1–1440 minutes, no second confirmation

name: 成员解禁
Unmute member
rule: 校验唯一目标及当前身份；不需要二次确认
Validate the unique target and current identity; no second confirmation

name: 手动踢出
Manual removal
rule: 业务内容规则模式：私聊预览，再由同一管理员用新消息确认；确认码单次、十分钟有效。旧模式仍按固定动作执行
Content-rule mode: private preview then a new confirmation from the same admin; single-use ten-minute token. Legacy mode retains fixed-action execution

name: 发布公告
Publish announcement
rule: 群内使用当前群；私聊须先选群；仍需平台原生管理角色
Current group in group chat; select group privately; native management role still required

name: 全员禁言与解除
Mute/unmute all
rule: 各动作分别授权；人工操作先暂停该群定时规则
Each action needs its own grant; manual action first pauses the group's schedule

name: 抽奖设置与历史
Lottery settings and history
rule: 管理员私聊选群后查询；不是公共群内命令
Admin private query after selecting a group; not a public group command

name: 抽奖参数
Lottery parameters
examples: 领奖联系人 管理员
rule: 设置下期参数；活动已开不能修改；只设置不自动开启
Configure the next lottery; active settings cannot change; settings alone do not open it

name: 抽奖开启与结束
Lottery lifecycle
rule: 需当前群主动发送授权与回复；开奖结果持久化一次发布；不自动派奖
Requires current-group proactive authorization and replies; durable once-only result publication; no automatic payout

name: 邀请奖励设置与查询
Invitation reward administration
rule: 全群统一积分值；启用建立基线，待审核不计奖；修改值不重算旧账
Uniform group points; enabling baselines existing members; pending joins earn nothing; no repricing old credits

name: 每日定时任务
Daily schedule
rule: 创建和恢复须新预览确认及两个动作授权；状态查询不执行动作；运行时再核验创建者权限；暂停和删除不解禁
Creation/resume require fresh confirmation and both grants; status queries execute no action; recheck creator at runtime; pause/delete do not unmute

name: 自然语言管理工具
Natural-language management tool
rule: 固定工具与配置草案；操作仍需独立授权；配置不直接处罚或开启活动，踢出及定时仍需明确确认
Fixed tools and config drafts with independent grants; settings do not punish or start activities, and removal/schedules still require explicit confirmation

name: 成员名片维护
Member card maintenance
rule: 管理员私聊AI支持指定成员改名及批量规范，预览后另发确认；当前成员快照及原名再次核验；按群自动扫描开关也需配置确认且不得自行授权

Admin private AI supports single-member custom cards and batch normalization with separate confirmation; recheck member identity and original card; per-group automatic scans require a confirmed setting and existing grants

name: 封禁／注销账号清理
Banned/cancelled-account cleanup
rule: 仅机器人页预览、确认与执行；cleanup 不继承 kick 或 rename；不自动运行
Bot-page preview, confirmation and execution only; cleanup does not inherit kick/rename; not automatic

name: 操作者身份
Caller identity
boundary: 群主、平台管理员、昵称及 @ 目标不能代替；撤权立即作用于后续调用
Group owners/admins, names and mention targets are no substitute; revocation affects subsequent calls

name: 机器人动作授权
Bot capabilities
source: 群授权中的逐群动作白名单
Per-group action allowlist in Group Grants
boundary: 只控制机器人可做的动作，不把任何群员变成管理员
Controls bot actions only; never makes a group member an administrator

name: 平台原生权限
Upstream permissions
source: 机器人在旺商聊的真实群角色及目标成员身份
Bot's real upstream group role and target member identity
boundary: 保存授权不等于平台允许执行；群管理角色和机器人目标受保护
A saved grant is not upstream permission; protected roles and bot targets stay protected

name: 主动发送授权
Proactive-send authority
source: 机器人页的主动发送目标白名单
boundary: 抽奖通知需目标群授权；不替代调用者身份或处罚动作授权
Lottery notices need the target-group grant; never replaces caller or sanction authority

name: 管理面板权限
Dashboard authority
source: Dashboard JWT 登录及 bot 范围
Dashboard JWT sign-in and bot scope
boundary: 与聊天管理员分开；插件 API 范围不能代替 bot 范围
Separate from chat admins; plugin API scope does not replace bot scope

name: 自动任务与测试窗口
Automation and test windows
source: 单独启用的规则、调度及有界开发窗口
Explicit automation, schedules and bounded test windows
boundary: 自动审核不要求被审成员是管理员；定时／活动重核验创建者；测试窗口不授予任何管理权限
Reviewed members need not be admins; schedules/activities recheck creator authority; test windows grant no management authority
